_developmentTeamNote: Apple Developer Team ID. Capacitor has no first-class teamId field (still true on 8.6); this entry is source-of-truth documentation. The actual value is applied to ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj (DEVELOPMENT_TEAM and CODE_SIGN_STYLE = Automatic) after `cap add ios`. If you regenerate the iOS project, re-apply.
_iosIncludePluginsNote: ios.includePlugins is an ALLOWLIST: `cap sync ios` installs only what is named there, so a new plugin must be added to it or iOS silently ships without it (tests/unit/ios-plugin-allowlist.test.js fails first). It exists for one reason: @sentry/capacitor dropped CocoaPods in 4.4.0 (Swift Package Manager only), and this iOS project is still on CocoaPods, where `pod install` stops at 'No podspec found for SentryCapacitor'. Android gets the plugin; iOS keeps the JavaScript-only Sentry it had. Delete the list, and this note, the day the iOS project moves to SPM.
